items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...was Joe Nanton -- you know, Tricky Sam. [INTERVIEWER] You heard him on records and stuff? [INTERVIEWER] Yeah... I met him years ago.

ctx.x: There's been quite a few trumpet players that used plungers. But the one on the trombone, that first started trombone playing with the plunger, was Joe Nanton -- you know, Tricky Sam.
You heard him on records and stuff?
